title: PBA: Serbian coach downplays role in Converge semis breakthrough

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Converge active consultant Djordje Jovicic is glad to have played a part in the franchise’s first-ever semifinals appearance by way of taking down Rain or Shine in their PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series. The Serbian mentor, however, downplayed his significance in the breakthrough feat, even though the FiberXers have been on a roll since he came back to help out coach Delta Pineda on the sidelines.
